name: Felsőnána (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőnána: a crowned white shield with a black tree and a green mound, with white mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed FELSŐNÁNA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Felsőnána arms with crown, mantling and scroll
